app_fee.value: The application fee is $40 for international applicants.

fee_waiver.value: No application fee waiver is stated on the international or general graduate admission pages.

gre_general.value: Each program sets its own GRE rule; the graduate school says GRE is needed only if the program requires it.
gre_general.quote: Graduate Record Exam (if applicable and required by the program)

toefl_min.value: The minimum TOEFL score is 4.0. The page gives no iBT scale, so this is read as the new-scale score.
toefl_min.quote: Test of English as a Foreign Language 4.0

english_waiver.value: India is not on the country exemption list, so Indian applicants must submit a test score. A U.S. accredited degree is the other exemption.
english_waiver.quote: To demonstrate English language proficiency, international applicants must meet the minimum scores on one of the following exams

also.quote: Waiver of English Language Proficiency Test Based on Country of Citizenship
Applicants that have completed a baccalaureate or graduate degree from an U.S. accredited institution

notes: Duolingo English Test 100 is also accepted. The $400 international enrollment deposit is not an application fee. Fall deadline December 15, spring October 15 (general graduate application); some departments set earlier deadlines. Engineering programs apply through EngineeringCAS, which has its own rules; the graduate GRE code is 6653 and engineering uses 2862. Fee waivers were not found on the pages checked.
